tours.rawDescription:
Discover the underwater beauty of the Red Sea on a Dolphin House Snorkeling Trip from Hurghada. This full-day boat excursion takes you toward Shaab El Erg, the well-known reef area associated with Dolphin House, where you can look for wild dolphins, explore colorful coral reefs, enjoy a buffet lunch, and experience fun water activities.

Combining dolphin watching opportunities, guided snorkeling, and a banana boat ride, this Dolphin House Hurghada excursion offers a varied day at sea for travelers who want to experience the marine life and coastal scenery of the Red Sea.

Visit Shaab El Erg, the Famous Dolphin House Reef

Your Dolphin House boat trip from Hurghada begins with hotel pickup at approximately 8:00 AM, followed by a transfer to Hurghada Marina. After boarding the boat, meet the crew and listen to the itinerary and safety briefing before sailing into the Red Sea.

The journey takes you toward Shaab El Erg, a reef area known for its association with wild dolphins and often referred to as Dolphin House. Here, you have the opportunity to look for dolphins swimming in their natural environment and observe their behavior from the water.

Dolphins are wild animals, so sightings and opportunities to see them underwater cannot be guaranteed. Their movements, weather, and sea conditions influence each encounter. Guests should follow the crew's instructions and avoid chasing, touching, feeding, or disturbing the animals.

Explore Coral Reefs on a Hurghada Snorkeling Trip

Your Dolphin House snorkeling trip continues with time in the water at the planned snorkeling locations. During the first stop, you can explore the marine environment around the Dolphin House area, looking for colorful fish, coral formations, and other Red Sea marine life.

The program then continues to a second snorkeling location, where you can spend approximately one hour discovering more of the underwater scenery. Snorkeling locations and conditions may vary depending on weather, visibility, and the crew's safety decisions.

Whether you are an experienced snorkeler or trying the activity for the first time, follow the guide's instructions and use the appropriate safety equipment. The experience is designed to combine wildlife observation with time to appreciate the coral reefs around Hurghada.

Buffet Lunch, Drinks, and Banana Boat Ride

Between your snorkeling sessions, relax onboard and enjoy the drinks provided as part of your booking. A freshly prepared open-buffet lunch is served on the boat, with vegetarian and vegan options available according to the menu and catering arrangements.

The excursion also includes a banana boat ride, adding a fun water activity to your day. Together, the snorkeling stops, dolphin watching opportunities, onboard dining, and banana boat ride make this more than a standard Hurghada snorkeling boat trip.

Please check your booking details for the exact inclusions, including drinks, snorkeling equipment, and any applicable marine park fees.

What to Expect from Your Dolphin House Trip from Hurghada

This full-day Dolphin House tour combines a morning hotel pickup, a boat journey to the Shaab El Erg area, opportunities to observe wild dolphins, two snorkeling stops, an onboard buffet lunch, and a banana boat ride.

After the day's activities, the boat returns to Hurghada Marina, where your transfer takes you back to your hotel according to your booking arrangements. The schedule may change due to weather, sea conditions, or safety requirements.

If you are looking for a Shaab El Erg snorkeling trip that combines the chance to encounter wild dolphins with coral reef exploration and water activities, this excursion offers a convenient way to experience one of Hurghada's well-known marine destinations.

tours.rawDescription:
An Abu Monkar White Island Speedboat Trip from Hurghada is the quick, beautiful island escape most visitors never hear about. Sitting just off the coast — one of the very closest islands to Hurghada — Abu Monkar is a white-sand hideaway of powdery beaches, glassy turquoise shallows, and easy, colorful reefs. On a private speedboat, you skip the crowded group boats and cruise straight to a slice of the Red Sea that still feels untouched.

What sets Abu Monkar apart is its wild side: a hidden lagoon at the island's heart, fringed with mangroves and busy with sea birds, gives the "White Island" a natural beauty all its own. Snorkel the reefs, wander the shell-strewn sand, and relax at your own pace. Keep it easy with the 4-hour half-day, or choose the full 8-hour day and add a magical snorkeling encounter with wild dolphins along the way.

Why You'll Love This Trip

Abu Monkar is Hurghada's nearest island secret. Because it sits so close to the coast, you spend less time traveling and more time on the sand — yet it stays wonderfully quiet, a genuine hidden gem while the bigger islands fill up with group boats.

The "White Island" name is well earned: the sand is powder-soft and blindingly bright, and the water glows turquoise. But the real surprise is the island's inner lagoon, ringed with mangroves and alive with sea birds, giving Abu Monkar a wild, natural character you simply won't find on the beach-club islands.

A private speedboat makes it effortless and personal. You beat the crowds, set your own timing, and let your skipper and guide handle everything while you snorkel easy reefs and relax on the sand. Add wild dolphins on the full-day option, and this quiet escape becomes a full Red Sea adventure.

Tour Experience

Half-Day Private Speedboat · 4 Hours

After a comfortable pickup from your Hurghada hotel, you'll board your private speedboat at the marina and skim across the Red Sea — Abu Monkar is close, so you're on the water and into the fun quickly. Your guide leads a snorkel over the island's calm, colorful reefs, then it's time to step onto the powdery white sand, swim in the glassy shallows, and explore the shell-strewn shore and its mangrove-fringed lagoon before your scenic cruise back to Hurghada.

Full-Day Private Speedboat with Dolphins · 8 Hours

The full-day adventure gives you the Red Sea at its best. Along with plenty of time on Abu Monkar's white sand and lagoon, you'll cruise to a wild-dolphin area for the chance to snorkel near spinner dolphins in their natural home, and enjoy extra reef stops packed with marine life. With eight unhurried hours, fresh fruit and drinks flowing, and an optional lunch on board, it's a complete day of sun, sea, and once-in-a-lifetime moments.

Perfect For

  • Travelers who want a quick, quiet island escape close to Hurghada
  • Nature lovers drawn to the mangrove lagoon and its sea birds
  • Families who want calm, shallow water and soft white sand
  • Beginner snorkelers who prefer easy, colorful reefs
  • Couples seeking a peaceful, crowd-free beach day
  • Groups who want a private boat and flexible timing

Reserve your private Abu Monkar White Island speedboat trip from Hurghada today, choose your half-day or full-day option, and confirm your date instantly. A quiet white-sand escape — with wild dolphins on the full day — is waiting. Book now with Marsa Waves.

Discover one of the Red Sea's most famous marine destinations on this Marsa Mubarak Snorkeling Trip from Hurghada. Located near Marsa Alam, Marsa Mubarak Reef is renowned for its crystal-clear waters, healthy seagrass meadows, colorful coral reefs, and the rare opportunity to swim with dugongs and green sea turtles in their natural habitat.

Your Marsa Mubarak Tour from Hurghada begins with an early hotel pick-up at 5:00 AM in a comfortable air-conditioned vehicle. After arriving at Quseir Marina, you'll board the boat and sail toward Marsa Mubarak, one of Egypt's top snorkeling destinations. Before entering the water, your guide provides a complete briefing covering the day's itinerary, marine life, snorkeling tips, and safety instructions.

Your first adventure takes you by zodiac boat to the famous Dugong Marsa Mubarak area, where you'll spend up to one hour searching for the gentle sea cow while snorkeling through calm, shallow waters filled with vibrant marine life. This is one of the best places for snorkeling with dugongs in Egypt.

After your first snorkeling session, relax onboard and enjoy a freshly prepared open-buffet lunch with vegetarian and vegan options while cruising through the beautiful Red Sea.

The second snorkeling stop focuses on the protected turtle feeding grounds of Marsa Mubarak Reef. Another zodiac ride brings you closer to areas where green sea turtles are frequently seen, allowing you to snorkel among colorful coral gardens, tropical fish, and one of the Red Sea's richest underwater ecosystems.

At the end of your Marsa Mubarak Snorkeling Tour, you'll sail back to Quseir Marina before returning comfortably to your hotel in Hurghada.

Book your Marsa Mubarak Snorkeling Trip from Hurghada today and experience one of Egypt's best snorkeling locations, where dugongs, sea turtles, pristine coral reefs, and unforgettable Red Sea wildlife await.

Discover the timeless beauty of southern Egypt on an unforgettable Aswan Tour from Hurghada, a full-day cultural journey through the heart of Upper Egypt. This guided Aswan Day Trip from Hurghada takes you to some of Egypt's most famous historical landmarks, including the magnificent Philae Temple, the impressive High Dam, the remarkable Unfinished Obelisk, and a relaxing Nile River Cruise.

Your Hurghada to Aswan Tour begins with an early departure by flight or private vehicle, allowing you to enjoy a full day exploring one of Egypt's most fascinating cities with the guidance of an experienced Egyptologist.

Visit the High Dam in Aswan

Your Aswan City Tour starts at the famous High Dam, one of Egypt's greatest modern engineering achievements. Learn how this remarkable structure transformed the Nile River, created Lake Nasser, and continues to play a vital role in Egypt's water and electricity supply while enjoying panoramic views of the surrounding landscape.

Explore the Unfinished Obelisk

Continue your Aswan Day Trip with a visit to the ancient granite quarry, home to the extraordinary Unfinished Obelisk. Discover how the ancient Egyptians carved massive stone monuments and gain fascinating insight into the incredible craftsmanship that helped build temples and monuments throughout Ancient Egypt.

Discover the Magnificent Philae Temple

One of the highlights of every Aswan Tour from Hurghada is the breathtaking Philae Temple, dedicated to the goddess Isis. Reach this beautiful island temple by a short boat ride across the Nile before exploring its magnificent columns, detailed hieroglyphics, and remarkably preserved ancient architecture with your guide.

Enjoy a Scenic Nile River Cruise

After visiting Aswan's iconic landmarks, relax on a peaceful Nile River Cruise and admire the beauty of the Nile as it flows through the city. This leisurely cruise offers stunning views of the riverbanks, islands, and traditional feluccas, creating one of the most memorable moments of your Hurghada to Aswan Tour.

Lunch & Shopping in Aswan

During your Aswan Tour, enjoy a freshly prepared lunch at a local restaurant before exploring Aswan's vibrant markets. Browse traditional handicrafts, Nubian souvenirs, spices, perfumes, and handmade products while experiencing the authentic atmosphere of this historic city.

Whether you are passionate about ancient history, Egyptian culture, or spectacular Nile scenery, this Full-Day Aswan Tour from Hurghada combines history, archaeology, and unforgettable sightseeing into one complete experience.

Book your Aswan Tour from Hurghada today and discover why Aswan remains one of Egypt's most extraordinary cultural destinations.

tours.rawDescription:
Hurghada is the closest Red Sea resort to Cairo, which makes this private Cairo Day Trip from Hurghada one of the easiest ways to see Egypt’s greatest monuments without leaving your beach holiday for a night. Travel with your own small group and a dedicated Egyptologist guide to the Giza Pyramids, the Great Sphinx, the Grand Egyptian Museum and historic Old Cairo, all in one well-planned day.

Why Book a Private Cairo Tour from Hurghada?

Skip the crowded coach and the long waits at other hotels. Your group of up to 8 travels in its own air-conditioned vehicle: a sedan for 1–3 travelers, a minivan for 4–5, or a Toyota HiAce for larger groups. The ride is quieter, the day runs on your group’s pace, and your guide’s attention stays with you.

The Pyramids of Giza and the Great Sphinx

Begin on the Giza Plateau, where the Great Pyramid of Khufu still rises above the desert after more than 4,500 years. Take in the pyramids of Khafre and Menkaure, then head down to the Great Sphinx, the colossal limestone guardian with a lion’s body and a pharaoh’s head.

Your Egyptologist guide shares how and why the pyramids were built and points out the best spots for photos.

Tutankhamun at the Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM)

Just minutes from the pyramids, the Grand Egyptian Museum is the largest archaeological museum in the world dedicated to a single civilization.

Climb the Grand Staircase lined with statues of kings and gods, stand beneath the giant statue of Ramses II, and see the complete Tutankhamun collection, displayed together for the first time.

Lunch, Old Cairo and Souvenir Shopping

Enjoy an oriental buffet lunch, then continue to Old Cairo, where Coptic and Islamic heritage meet in historic streets and landmarks. Before heading back, take time to shop for papyrus, perfume oils and handmade Egyptian souvenirs.

Good to Know Before You Go

The drive from Hurghada to Cairo takes around 5 to 6 hours, so pickup is around 2:00 AM and you reach Giza by morning. Hotel pickup is available from Hurghada, El Gouna, Sahl Hasheesh and Makadi Bay, and your exact time is confirmed after booking.

Prefer a slower pace? Choose our 2-Day Cairo Overnight Tour from Hurghada and spend a night in Cairo.

Explore Hurghada Marina and the Red Sea Waterfront

Your Hurghada City Tour begins with hotel pickup at approximately 9:00 AM, according to the current itinerary. From there, you'll head out to discover some of the city's best-known landmarks with your guide.

One of the highlights is Hurghada Marina, a popular waterfront area featuring yachts, cafés, restaurants, and views of the Red Sea. Walk along the promenade, take photographs, and enjoy a different perspective on Hurghada beyond its beach resorts.

tours.rawDescription:
Discover the wonders of ancient Egypt on a Private Luxor Day Trip from Hurghada. Travel from the Red Sea coast to Luxor, the historic city of ancient Thebes, and explore some of Egypt's most remarkable archaeological sites, including the Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut Temple, the Colossi of Memnon, and the magnificent Karnak Temple Complex.

With a private, air-conditioned vehicle and a professional Egyptologist guide, this full-day Luxor tour from Hurghada combines fascinating history, impressive ancient architecture, and a more flexible sightseeing experience. Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant, explore Luxor's central market, and choose an optional Nile cruise to Banana Island for an additional cost.

Travel from Hurghada to the Ancient City of Luxor

Your private Luxor excursion from Hurghada begins with hotel pickup and a drive through the Eastern Desert toward the Nile Valley. Leaving the Red Sea resorts behind, you'll travel inland to discover a very different side of Egypt, shaped by ancient temples, royal tombs, and thousands of years of history.

Travel in a private, air-conditioned vehicle with your own group, giving you a more personal alternative to a shared bus excursion. The journey takes several hours each way, so an early departure is expected for this full-day experience.

Upon arrival in Luxor, meet your Egyptologist guide and begin exploring the monuments that made this destination one of the world's most important centers of ancient Egyptian civilization.

Explore the Valley of the Kings and Royal Tombs

Begin your archaeological adventure on Luxor's West Bank at the Valley of the Kings, the famous burial ground of many New Kingdom pharaohs. Enter the tombs included in your admission arrangements and discover painted chambers, detailed inscriptions, and scenes that reveal ancient Egyptian beliefs about the afterlife.

Your Egyptologist guide will explain the history of the royal necropolis and the significance of its decorated burial chambers, helping you understand the stories behind these remarkable monuments.

The tombs available to visit depend on the applicable entrance ticket and any separately charged special tomb admissions. Check your booking details to confirm exactly which tickets are included.

Visit Hatshepsut Temple and the Colossi of Memnon

Continue your Luxor day trip from Hurghada to the Temple of Hatshepsut, one of Egypt's most distinctive mortuary temples. Built against the dramatic cliffs of Deir el-Bahari, the temple is known for its terraced design, monumental colonnades, and connection to Queen Hatshepsut, one of ancient Egypt's most remarkable rulers.

Your journey continues to the Colossi of Memnon, two enormous stone statues representing Pharaoh Amenhotep III. Standing on the West Bank, these famous monuments offer an opportunity to appreciate the scale of ancient Egyptian sculpture and take memorable photographs.

Together, these sites provide a closer look at the royal history, religious traditions, and architectural achievements of ancient Thebes.

Discover the Karnak Temple Complex

Cross to Luxor's East Bank to explore the magnificent Karnak Temple Complex, one of the largest religious complexes ever constructed. Developed and expanded by successive pharaohs over many centuries, Karnak contains monumental gateways, towering columns, obelisks, and sacred spaces that reflect the power and religious traditions of ancient Egypt.

Walk through the complex with your Egyptologist guide and learn how different rulers contributed to its construction. The Great Hypostyle Hall, with its forest of massive columns, is among the site's most impressive features.

A visit to Karnak completes the experience of exploring both banks of Luxor, combining the royal burial grounds of the West Bank with the monumental religious architecture of the East Bank.

Enjoy Lunch and Explore Luxor's Local Market

After visiting the main archaeological sites, take a break with lunch at a local restaurant, included according to the current tour package. This provides time to relax and recharge before continuing your day in Luxor.

You can also browse Luxor's central market, where local shops offer souvenirs, spices, perfumes, and other Egyptian products. Explore at your own pace, enjoy the local atmosphere, and look for a keepsake from your visit to this historic city.

Shopping time and the order of the stops may vary according to the day's schedule and the time available at each attraction.

Optional Banana Island Nile Cruise

Add another experience to your private Luxor tour with an optional 45-minute Banana Island cruise on the Nile, available at an additional cost. Enjoy views of the river and surrounding landscapes as you travel toward the island, known for its lush vegetation and banana plantations.

This optional activity offers a relaxing contrast to the day's archaeological sightseeing. If you'd prefer to include the cruise, confirm its availability, price, and timing with the tour operator before booking.

Why Choose a Private Luxor Day Trip from Hurghada?

A private Luxor day trip is ideal for travelers who want to explore ancient Egyptian history with their own group rather than join a shared excursion. Having a private vehicle and an Egyptologist guide creates a more personal sightseeing experience and allows for a more flexible pace, subject to the day's itinerary and site regulations.

The tour brings together the Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut Temple, the Colossi of Memnon, and Karnak Temple in one long day, with lunch and a visit to the local market. It is particularly suitable for couples, families, and small groups who want to discover Luxor without arranging an overnight stay.

Because the drive from Hurghada is substantial, prepare for an early start and a long day of travel and sightseeing. The exact schedule depends on your pickup location, traffic, site access, and the time available at each attraction.

Whether you're looking for a Hurghada Quad Biking Desert Safari, an off-road adventure, or a desert experience that includes Bedouin hospitality, this tour brings several activities together in one trip. Start Your Hurghada Desert Adventure with Hotel Pickup

Your Hurghada Desert Adventure Tour begins with hotel pickup and a transfer to the quad bike station. Once you arrive, your guide provides a safety briefing and explains how to operate the quad bike, follow the desert route, and observe the safety instructions throughout the excursion.

After the introduction, get ready to leave the resort area behind and explore the desert trails. The experience is designed to combine guided outdoor activities with opportunities to appreciate the Eastern Desert's open landscapes and rugged terrain.

Experience Quad Biking Across the Eastern Desert

Follow your guide through the designated trails, with stops arranged according to the excursion's schedule and safety requirements. Whether you're interested in quad biking for the adventure or the desert views, this activity is a central part of the Hurghada desert safari experience.

Discover the Desert on a 4x4 Jeep Safari

The camel ride and camp visit add a cultural element to the trip, making this more than a standard quad bike excursion from Hurghada.

Choose a Morning or Sunset Desert Safari

A Relaxing Outdoor Experience in Hurghada

Learn to Dive in Hurghada with Professional Guidance

Your instructor will guide you through the basic skills needed for your first dives and explain how to use your equipment correctly. The training is designed to help beginners become familiar with the underwater environment while following the instructor's directions and safety requirements.

Relax with an Open-Buffet Lunch Onboard

Between diving sessions, return to the boat and enjoy a freshly prepared open-buffet lunch. Take a break, relax between activities, and enjoy the surrounding Red Sea scenery before continuing with the day's diving program.

What to Expect from Your Beginner Diving Course in Hurghada

This beginner diving experience combines instructor-led scuba training, two diving sessions, and an onboard buffet lunch. It is suitable for travelers who want to discover scuba diving, become familiar with diving equipment, and explore the Red Sea under professional supervision.

If you are looking for a way to learn to dive in Hurghada, experience your first scuba dives, and explore the underwater beauty of the Red Sea, this beginner-friendly excursion offers an accessible starting point.

Step into thousands of years of civilization with this unforgettable Hurghada Museum Tour, one of the best cultural experiences in the Red Sea region. Your Hurghada Museum Tour begins with convenient hotel pickup in a comfortable air-conditioned vehicle. Choose between the morning session (10:00 AM – 1:00 PM) or the evening session (5:00 PM – 8:00 PM), making this experience ideal for every travel schedule.

Explore the Hurghada Museum

Inside the Hurghada Museum, your professional guide will introduce you to one of Egypt's most impressive museum collections outside Cairo. Discover beautifully preserved statues, ancient jewelry, royal artifacts, everyday objects, and remarkable works of art that illustrate the evolution of Egyptian civilization over thousands of years.

Discover Ancient Egypt

Begin your journey through Ancient Egypt, where you'll learn about the pharaohs, temples, religious beliefs, and daily life while viewing carefully selected artifacts that reflect one of the world's greatest civilizations.

Greco-Roman, Coptic & Islamic Heritage

Continue exploring the fascinating Greco-Roman, Coptic, and Islamic galleries, each highlighting a different chapter of Egyptian history through sculptures, manuscripts, decorative arts, religious objects, and historical treasures.

Modern Egyptian Culture

The final section of the Hurghada Museum introduces visitors to modern Egyptian culture, displaying artwork and exhibits that connect Egypt's rich heritage with its contemporary identity.

Whether you're passionate about archaeology, history, art, or simply looking for one of the best cultural activities in Hurghada, this Hurghada Museum Tour offers an enriching experience for individuals, couples, families, and anyone interested in discovering Egypt beyond its beaches.

After your visit, relax during your comfortable transfer back to your hotel, taking with you a deeper appreciation of Egypt's remarkable history and cultural heritage.

tours.rawDescription:
Experience one of Egypt’s most unforgettable cultural adventures on this Luxor Hot Air Balloon Tour from Hurghada. This carefully planned 2-Day Overnight Luxor Tour from Hurghada combines ancient temples, royal tombs, breathtaking Nile scenery, and the unforgettable opportunity to enjoy an optional Luxor Hot Air Balloon Ride at sunrise.

Your Luxor Trip from Hurghada begins with an early hotel pickup and a comfortable transfer to Luxor, where two days of history, culture, and spectacular sightseeing await.

Day 1 – Explore Luxor's East Bank

Your Luxor Overnight Tour from Hurghada begins by exploring the magnificent Karnak Temple, the largest ancient religious complex ever built. Walk among its towering columns, sacred lakes, and impressive temples while learning about thousands of years of Egyptian history from your professional guide.

The journey continues to the world-famous Luxor Temple, one of Ancient Egypt’s most beautiful monuments, famous for its colossal statues, grand entrance, and remarkable hieroglyphic inscriptions.

After exploring Luxor's East Bank, enjoy a freshly prepared Egyptian lunch before experiencing the spectacular Karnak Sound & Light Show, where fascinating stories, dramatic lighting, and historical narration bring the ancient city back to life.

At the end of the day, check into your comfortable hotel in Luxor and relax before the next day's adventure.

Day 2 – Optional Sunrise Luxor Hot Air Balloon Ride

Wake up before sunrise for the highlight of your journey—an optional Luxor Hot Air Balloon Ride. As your balloon gently rises above the Nile Valley, enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of ancient temples, green farmland, desert mountains, and the winding Nile River. This unforgettable Hot Air Balloon Luxor experience is considered one of the most spectacular sunrise activities in Egypt.

After breakfast, your Luxor Tour from Hurghada continues with a guided visit to the legendary Valley of the Kings, where generations of pharaohs were buried inside magnificent tombs carved deep into the mountains.

Next, explore the impressive Temple of Hatshepsut, one of Egypt's most extraordinary architectural masterpieces, beautifully built against the towering limestone cliffs of Luxor's West Bank.

Continue your journey with a relaxing Nile boat ride, offering beautiful views of the river and the surrounding landscapes before visiting the famous Colossi of Memnon, the two gigantic statues that have welcomed travelers to Luxor for thousands of years.

After enjoying another delicious local meal, spend some free time exploring Luxor's traditional markets, where you can shop for handmade souvenirs, spices, alabaster products, perfumes, and authentic Egyptian gifts before returning to Hurghada.

An Unforgettable 2-Day Luxor Adventure

Whether you dream of flying above ancient temples in a Luxor Hot Air Balloon, discovering the legendary Valley of the Kings, exploring Karnak Temple, visiting Luxor Temple, or relaxing on the Nile, this 2-Day Luxor Tour from Hurghada combines Egypt's greatest historical treasures into one unforgettable experience.

Book your Luxor Hot Air Balloon Tour from Hurghada today and discover why Luxor remains one of the world's greatest open-air museums.

Experience one of the Red Sea’s most memorable marine adventures on a Sataya Dolphin House snorkeling tour from Marsa Alam. Also known as Sataya Reef Dolphin House, this remote lagoon near Hamata is famous for its wild spinner dolphins, crystal-clear waters, vibrant coral reefs, and exceptional snorkeling opportunities.

Wild Dolphins at Sataya Reef

Sataya Reef is a natural marine environment where wild spinner dolphins live and move freely. Unlike marine parks or controlled dolphin attractions, this experience takes place in the open sea, giving you the opportunity to observe dolphins in their natural habitat. Dolphin sightings cannot be guaranteed, but Sataya is well known for frequent encounters with dolphin pods.

Snorkeling & Marine Life

Beyond the dolphin encounter, Sataya Reef offers excellent snorkeling among colorful coral formations and tropical Red Sea fish. The warm waters and diverse marine life make the experience suitable for both first-time snorkelers and experienced swimmers, subject to sea and weather conditions.

What to Expect on the Trip

Your Dolphin House Marsa Alam trip begins with an early morning hotel pickup followed by a transfer to Hamata Marina. From there, you sail toward Sataya Reef for snorkeling and a possible wild dolphin encounter.

After your first snorkeling session, enjoy lunch onboard while taking in panoramic views of the Red Sea. The trip continues with another snorkeling stop, giving you more time to explore the reef and look for dolphins when conditions allow, before returning to Hamata Marina and your hotel in Marsa Alam.

If you are looking for a Sataya Dolphin House tour from Marsa Alam, this full-day experience combines wild dolphin encounters, reef snorkeling, a Red Sea boat trip, lunch, and hotel transfers in one memorable adventure.

Take your diving skills beyond exploration with the PADI Rescue Diver Course in Hurghada, a practical training program designed to help certified divers recognize potential problems, assist other divers, and respond more effectively to underwater emergencies. Through instructor-led exercises and realistic rescue scenarios, you'll develop the awareness, problem-solving skills, and confidence needed to become a safer and more responsible dive buddy.

Whether you want to improve your diving safety skills, prepare for more advanced training, or work toward a professional diving career, this PADI Rescue Diver course offers an important step in your development as a recreational diver.

Develop Essential Rescue Diver Skills

Your PADI Rescue Diver Course in Hurghada begins at the marina, where you meet your diving instructor and review the course schedule, safety procedures, equipment preparation, and planned training activities. Each session is designed to help you understand how to recognize risks and respond appropriately while keeping your own safety and the safety of other divers in mind.

Throughout the course, you'll practise self-rescue techniques, recognize signs of stress in other divers, assist tired or panicked divers, and develop the skills needed to respond to different diving emergencies. These exercises help you improve your awareness, decision-making, and ability to remain composed in challenging situations.

Practise Realistic Underwater Rescue Scenarios

The PADI Rescue Diver training combines practical skill development with supervised rescue scenarios in the water. Under your instructor's guidance, you'll practise diver assistance, emergency response procedures, search techniques, and other rescue exercises designed to prepare you for situations that may occur during recreational diving.

Each exercise builds on your existing diving experience and helps you understand how to assess a situation before taking action. You'll also learn why prevention, communication, and early recognition of diver stress are essential parts of responsible scuba diving.

Training activities are conducted under controlled conditions, with scenarios and locations selected according to the course plan, local conditions, and safety requirements.

Train at Selected Red Sea Dive Sites in Hurghada

The course takes place at selected dive sites around Hurghada, giving you the opportunity to practise your rescue skills in the Red Sea environment. Depending on weather conditions, visibility, and the instructor's assessment, potential locations may include the Giftun Islands, Abu Ramada Reef, Shaab El Erg, Umm Qamar, and other suitable dive sites.

Each training session focuses on developing practical rescue abilities rather than simply exploring the reef. Your instructor will select appropriate locations and conditions for the planned exercises, helping you build experience while keeping safety at the center of the training.

Enjoy Onboard Lunch During Your Rescue Training

Between training sessions, relax on board and enjoy a freshly prepared buffet lunch, including vegetarian options. The boat provides a place to rest between exercises before continuing with the day's planned rescue training.

The course combines instructor-led learning, practical water sessions, and time at selected Red Sea dive sites. This structured experience helps you focus on developing your rescue skills while enjoying the convenience of a boat-based diving program.

Located south of Marsa Alam, Wadi El Gemal National Park brings together desert landscapes, rugged mountains, mangrove-lined lagoons, sandy beaches, and vibrant Red Sea marine life. Experience one of the Red Sea’s most memorable marine adventures on a Samadai Dolphin House Snorkeling Trip from Marsa Alam. Also known as Sha'ab Samadai or Dolphin House, Samadai Reef is a protected marine area famous for its wild spinner dolphins, clear turquoise waters, colorful coral reefs, and rich Red Sea marine life.

Samadai Dolphin House & Wild Spinner Dolphins

Located off the coast of Marsa Alam, Samadai Reef is known for its horseshoe-shaped reef and sheltered lagoon, which provides an important resting area for wild spinner dolphins. During your Dolphin House Marsa Alam trip, you’ll have the opportunity to observe these dolphins in their natural environment while exploring the surrounding reef.

Dolphin sightings cannot be guaranteed because these are wild animals, but Samadai is well known for opportunities to encounter spinner dolphins. The experience follows responsible snorkeling practices, allowing you to enjoy the marine environment without disturbing the wildlife.

Snorkeling at Sha'ab Samadai Reef

Your Samadai Dolphin House tour begins with hotel pickup from Marsa Alam and a transfer to the marina, followed by a scenic boat trip toward Samadai Reef. After relaxing onboard and enjoying a freshly prepared buffet lunch, the trip continues with a second snorkeling session around Dolphin House. This gives you another opportunity to explore the reef and look for wild spinner dolphins while enjoying the surrounding marine scenery.

This full-day Samadai Reef snorkeling experience combines a Red Sea boat trip, two snorkeling sessions, marine wildlife, coral reef exploration, lunch onboard, and hotel transfers from Marsa Alam.

Whether you’re a first-time snorkeler, traveling with family, or an experienced swimmer, Samadai Dolphin House offers a chance to experience one of Marsa Alam’s best-known marine wildlife destinations, subject to sea and weather conditions.

If you’re looking for a Dolphin House snorkeling trip from Marsa Alam, this experience gives you the opportunity to explore Sha'ab Samadai, discover its coral reefs, and look for wild spinner dolphins in their natural habitat.

tours.rawDescription:
This private Cairo Day Trip from Marsa Alam is the most comfortable way to see Egypt’s greatest wonders in a single day. Travel with your own small group of up to 8 people in an air-conditioned vehicle, with a dedicated Egyptologist guide for the Giza Pyramids, the Great Sphinx, the Grand Egyptian Museum and historic Old Cairo.

Why Choose a Private Cairo Tour from Marsa Alam?

Forget crowded tour buses. Your vehicle is matched to your group size: a sedan for 1–3 travelers, a minivan for 4–5, and a Toyota HiAce for larger groups. You travel only with your own small group, your guide has time for your questions, and the long journey from the Red Sea is far more relaxing.

The Great Pyramids of Giza & the Sphinx

Your day starts on the Giza Plateau. Stand before the Great Pyramid of Khufu, the only one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World still standing, and see the pyramids of Khafre and Menkaure.

Then meet the Great Sphinx, the giant limestone guardian with a lion’s body and a pharaoh’s face, while your guide shares 4,500 years of history and the best photo spots.

The Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM)

Minutes from the pyramids, the Grand Egyptian Museum is the largest archaeological museum in the world dedicated to a single civilization.

Climb the Grand Staircase lined with royal statues, stand beneath the colossal statue of Ramses II, and see the complete Tutankhamun collection, including his golden treasures.

Historic Old Cairo & Shopping

After an oriental buffet lunch, continue to Old Cairo, where centuries of Coptic and Islamic heritage meet in historic lanes and landmarks. End the day with time to shop for papyrus, perfume oils and handmade souvenirs.

Good to Know

Cairo is around 8 hours by road from Marsa Alam, so the tour starts with a pickup around midnight and you arrive in Cairo in the morning. Pickup time depends on your hotel’s location and is confirmed after booking. Hotel pickup is also available from Port Ghalib and El Quseir.

Prefer less time on the road? Choose our 2-Day Cairo Overnight Tour from Marsa Alam and spend the night in Cairo.

Day 1: Discover the West Bank of Luxor

Your Luxor trip from Marsa Alam begins with an early departure and a comfortable journey through the desert and Nile Valley toward Luxor. Accompanied by an experienced Egyptologist guide, you'll explore the West Bank, home to some of ancient Egypt's most important archaeological sites.

Visit the Valley of the Kings, where powerful pharaohs were buried in elaborately decorated rock-cut tombs. Continue to the impressive Temple of Hatshepsut, with its distinctive terraces and monumental architecture, before visiting the Colossi of Memnon, the famous statues of Pharaoh Amenhotep III.

After exploring the West Bank, enjoy a traditional lunch before continuing your journey and settling in for your overnight stay.

Day 2: Karnak Temple & the Nile

After breakfast, continue exploring the ancient city of Thebes with a visit to the magnificent Karnak Temple Complex. Walk among its monumental columns, obelisks, statues, and hieroglyphic inscriptions while your Egyptologist guide explains the history of one of ancient Egypt's greatest religious centers.

You’ll also have the opportunity to enjoy a relaxing Nile cruise, taking in views of the river and the fertile landscapes that surround Luxor. After lunch and the final sightseeing activities, begin your return journey to Marsa Alam.

What to Expect from Your Overnight Luxor Trip

Unlike a standard Luxor day trip from Marsa Alam, this two-day experience gives you more time to explore the city's ancient monuments without trying to fit the entire experience into a single day. The overnight format allows you to experience both the archaeological highlights and the atmosphere of Luxor at a more comfortable pace.

If you're looking for a 2 Day Luxor Tour from Marsa Alam or an overnight trip that combines the Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut Temple, Karnak, and a Nile experience, this excursion offers a convenient way to discover one of Egypt's most important historical destinations while returning to the Red Sea after your stay.

Explore Aswan’s Famous Historical Landmarks

Your Aswan sightseeing tour introduces you to some of the city's most important attractions. Begin with the Aswan High Dam, a major engineering project that transformed water management and electricity generation in Egypt. Continue to the Ancient Granite Quarry to see the Unfinished Obelisk and learn how ancient Egyptian craftsmen worked with enormous blocks of granite to create monumental structures.

One of the main highlights is Philae Temple, dedicated to the goddess Isis. Located on an island in the Nile, this remarkable temple is known for its detailed carvings, impressive architecture, and scenic setting. A boat ride to the temple adds another memorable element to your Aswan city tour.

Enjoy a Felucca Ride on the Nile & Discover Local Culture

Your Aswan excursion also includes time to explore local markets and discover the city's cultural atmosphere. Browse Nubian handicrafts, spices, perfumes, and traditional souvenirs while experiencing a glimpse of everyday life in Aswan.

An Aswan Day Trip from Marsa Alam is an opportunity to explore southern Egypt beyond the Red Sea resorts. The itinerary combines ancient monuments, a scenic Nile experience, and local culture in one organized excursion.

Whether you are looking for an Aswan tour from Marsa Alam focused on ancient Egyptian history or a sightseeing experience that combines Philae Temple, the High Dam, the Unfinished Obelisk, and a felucca ride, this trip brings several of Aswan's best-known highlights together in one itinerary.

Sea Turtles at Abu Dabbab Bay

Abu Dabbab Bay is well known for its seagrass areas and shallow waters, where green sea turtles can often be seen feeding in their natural environment. The easy beach entry allows you to reach the snorkeling area directly from the shore, making it a convenient choice for travelers who want to experience Red Sea marine life without a long boat journey.

Sea turtle sightings cannot be guaranteed because these are wild animals, but Abu Dabbab is well known for the opportunity to encounter turtles while snorkeling. You may also see colorful reef fish, rays, and other marine life around the bay's coral and seagrass areas.

Easy Shore Snorkeling in Abu Dabbab

Unlike offshore snorkeling trips, this Abu Dabbab Bay snorkeling experience starts directly from the beach. The relatively shallow water and easy shore access make it suitable for beginners, families, and experienced snorkelers alike, subject to sea and weather conditions.

After your hotel pickup from Marsa Alam, you'll travel to Abu Dabbab Beach and begin your first snorkeling session. Explore the reef and seagrass areas at your own pace while looking for sea turtles and discovering the colorful marine life of the bay.

Your Abu Dabbab snorkeling trip includes hotel pickup and a comfortable transfer to the beach, followed by guided shore snorkeling in the clear Red Sea waters. After the first session, enjoy lunch and time to relax on the sandy beach before continuing with another snorkeling session or enjoying more beach time.

With no boat journey required, this experience gives you more time to enjoy the beach, snorkel close to shore, and explore one of the most accessible marine-wildlife destinations near Marsa Alam.

If you're looking for an Abu Dabbab turtle snorkeling experience from Marsa Alam, this trip combines easy shore access, the chance to encounter wild sea turtles, colorful coral reefs, lunch, snorkeling equipment, and hotel transfers in one relaxed Red Sea adventure.

Upon reaching Sataya Dolphin House, get ready to explore the clear waters of the Red Sea. Enjoy snorkeling among vibrant coral formations and colorful reef fish while discovering the underwater beauty that makes Sataya Reef a memorable destination for marine life enthusiasts.

Wild spinner dolphins are known to frequent the area, offering the possibility of seeing them in their natural environment. However, dolphin sightings cannot be guaranteed, and any encounter should take place responsibly, without disturbing the animals.

After your snorkeling session, take a break on the boat and enjoy a freshly prepared buffet lunch. Relax on deck, admire the surrounding seascape, and make the most of your time on the Red Sea.

Lunch provides an opportunity to recharge before continuing the adventure and enjoying more of the area's marine scenery.

Discover More of Sataya Reef

Continue your snorkeling experience with another opportunity to explore the reef and observe its diverse marine life. Whether you're admiring coral formations or watching colorful fish move through the water, each stop offers a different perspective on the underwater world of Sataya Dolphin House.

Your guide will provide instructions for the snorkeling stops and help you understand the safety procedures to follow throughout the trip.

Return to Port Ghalib Marina

One of the biggest attractions of Abu Dabbab snorkeling is the opportunity to observe wild green sea turtles swimming and feeding around the bay's seagrass meadows.

During your guided snorkeling session, explore the clear Red Sea waters while looking for these remarkable marine animals. The sandy seabed and surrounding seagrass habitats provide an important feeding environment for sea turtles, making Abu Dabbab a popular destination for wildlife enthusiasts.

If you're lucky, you may also encounter other fascinating marine creatures, including a rare dugong, sometimes called a sea cow.

Sea turtles and dugongs are wild animals, so sightings are never guaranteed. Your guide will help you enjoy the experience responsibly while respecting the marine life and its natural habitat.

Discover the natural wonders of Egypt's southern Red Sea on a Wadi El Gemal National Park Tour from Port Ghalib. This full-day snorkeling and nature excursion takes you to three remarkable destinations: the turquoise waters of Sharm El Luli Beach, the peaceful mangrove landscapes of Qulaan, and the spectacular natural swimming pool of Al Nayzak Lake.

Combining beach snorkeling, coastal exploration, and relaxing swimming stops, this Wadi El Gemal day trip offers an unforgettable way to experience the beauty of Marsa Alam beyond the resort beaches. Whether you love marine life, photography, or discovering unique natural landscapes, this excursion brings together some of the region's most distinctive attractions.

Start Your Wadi El Gemal Adventure from Port Ghalib

Your adventure begins with a convenient hotel pickup from Port Ghalib and a scenic drive south along Egypt's Red Sea coast toward Wadi El Gemal National Park.

As you travel through the coastal desert landscape, you'll discover a different side of Marsa Alam, where rugged mountains, sandy shores, and turquoise waters create spectacular natural scenery.

This full-day excursion is designed to combine several coastal attractions in one journey, allowing you to enjoy snorkeling, sightseeing, and relaxation without arranging separate trips.

Snorkel at Sharm El Luli Beach

Your first destination is the breathtaking Sharm El Luli Beach, also known as Hankorab Beach, one of the most beautiful snorkeling locations in the southern Red Sea.

Famous for its soft white sand, crystal-clear turquoise waters, and vibrant coral reefs, Sharm El Luli offers a wonderful setting for snorkeling and beach relaxation.

Enter the water from the shore and discover colorful coral formations, tropical reef fish, and the fascinating underwater environment of this protected coastal area.

Whether you're an experienced snorkeler or exploring the Red Sea for the first time, your guide will help you enjoy the snorkeling experience according to the day's sea conditions.

After exploring the reefs, take time to relax on the beautiful sandy beach, admire the coastal scenery, and capture memorable photographs.

Discover Qulaan Mangrove Forest and Coastal Lagoons

Continue your Wadi El Gemal excursion to the peaceful Qulaan Mangrove area, one of the southern Red Sea's most distinctive natural attractions.

Here, beautiful mangrove trees grow beside shallow coastal lagoons, creating an extraordinary landscape where desert scenery meets the sea.

Explore the peaceful surroundings, observe the unique mangrove ecosystem, and enjoy the opportunity to photograph the natural beauty of Qulaan.

Depending on local conditions and your guide's instructions, you can also enjoy the shallow coastal waters while appreciating the quiet atmosphere of this remarkable protected area.

The contrast between the turquoise water, green mangroves, and surrounding desert makes Qulaan a memorable highlight for nature lovers and photographers.

Swim and Relax at Al Nayzak Lake

The adventure continues to Al Nayzak Lake, also known as Meteor Lake or Nayzak Natural Pool, one of the most unusual coastal attractions near Marsa Alam.

This natural seawater pool is surrounded by rocky formations and offers a striking contrast between the clear blue water and the rugged coastal landscape.

Enjoy time to admire the scenery, take photographs, and swim when local safety conditions permit.

Unlike the open-water snorkeling experience at Sharm El Luli, this stop focuses on the beauty of the natural rock pool and its peaceful surroundings.

It's a beautiful way to complete your day of exploring the southern Red Sea coastline.

Experience Three Natural Wonders in One Day

What makes this Wadi El Gemal National Park excursion special is the opportunity to discover three different coastal environments in a single trip.

At Sharm El Luli, explore colorful coral reefs and enjoy a pristine sandy beach. At Qulaan, discover peaceful mangrove landscapes and shallow coastal lagoons. At Al Nayzak, experience one of Marsa Alam's most distinctive natural swimming spots.

The combination of guided snorkeling, scenic coastal stops, and relaxing moments by the water makes this excursion a great choice for couples, families, nature enthusiasts, and travelers looking to experience more than a typical beach holiday.

Discover the wonders of ancient Egypt on a Private Luxor Day Trip from Port Ghalib, combining the legendary Valley of the Kings, Karnak Temple, Hatshepsut Temple, and the Colossi of Memnon in one unforgettable sightseeing experience.

Travel from your Port Ghalib hotel in a private air-conditioned vehicle and explore Luxor with a professional Egyptologist guide. With a personalized itinerary, comfortable transfers, and lunch at a local restaurant, this private tour is ideal for couples, families, and travelers who prefer exploring Egypt's ancient treasures without joining a large group.

Start Your Private Luxor Tour from Port Ghalib

Your adventure begins with an early morning pickup from your hotel in Port Ghalib. Relax in your private air-conditioned vehicle as you travel through Egypt's Eastern Desert toward the historic city of Luxor.

Upon arrival, meet your Egyptologist guide and begin exploring the remarkable monuments of ancient Thebes, once one of the most important cities in the ancient Egyptian world.

A private Luxor excursion from Port Ghalib gives you a more personal sightseeing experience, with dedicated transportation and an expert guide who can answer your questions and bring the stories of the pharaohs to life.

The itinerary covers Luxor's most celebrated archaeological attractions, combining the royal tombs of the West Bank with the magnificent temples of the East Bank.

Explore the Valley of the Kings

Discover the famous Valley of the Kings, where many of ancient Egypt's New Kingdom pharaohs were buried in elaborate tombs carved into the desert mountains.

Walk through selected royal tombs and admire colorful hieroglyphics, ancient religious scenes, and beautifully decorated burial chambers.

Your Egyptologist guide will explain the significance of the valley, the beliefs surrounding the afterlife, and the history of the rulers buried here.

Access to individual tombs depends on the applicable entrance ticket, opening arrangements, and any additional ticket requirements.

Visit Hatshepsut Temple and the Colossi of Memnon

Continue your Luxor sightseeing tour to the spectacular Mortuary Temple of Hatshepsut at Deir el-Bahari.

Built against dramatic limestone cliffs, this extraordinary temple is famous for its impressive terraces, colonnades, and the remarkable story of Queen Hatshepsut, one of ancient Egypt's most influential female rulers.

Your journey also includes a stop at the Colossi of Memnon, two enormous seated statues of Pharaoh Amenhotep III that have stood on Luxor's West Bank for thousands of years.

From El Quseir to Luxor: Your Private Journey

Your day starts with an early pickup from your hotel in El Quseir. Travel inland from the Red Sea coast through the Eastern Desert toward the Nile Valley, watching the scenery shift from rugged mountains to cultivated fields and riverside towns.

The journey takes several hours each way, so plan for a long day, with an evening return. Road conditions, hotel location, and stops can affect the timetable. Your private vehicle and professional driver keep transportation organized while you concentrate on the experience ahead.

Unlike many shared Luxor day tours, this excursion is reserved for your booking party. It gives you a more personal way to discover the historic sites without waiting for a large bus group at every stop.

Enter the Royal Tombs in the Valley of the Kings

Your sightseeing begins on Luxor's West Bank, home to the Valley of the Kings. Carved into desert hills, these royal burial chambers preserve remarkable paintings, hieroglyphs, and scenes depicting ancient Egyptian beliefs about the afterlife.

Your Egyptologist introduces the history of the New Kingdom rulers and explains what makes the tombs significant. Then step inside tombs available for visiting under the admission arrangements for your selected date.

Travelling to the Valley of the Kings from El Quseir is a major highlight for visitors who want to experience ancient Egypt beyond the Red Sea resorts. Standard entry and certain special tombs have different ticket conditions; confirm any additional admission you want before travelling.

Discover the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut

Continue to Deir el-Bahari, where the Temple of Hatshepsut rises against steep limestone cliffs. Its broad terraces and colonnades create one of Luxor's most striking architectural sights.

Learn how Hatshepsut ruled as pharaoh and why her mortuary temple played an important role in royal remembrance and worship. The design makes a memorable contrast with the underground tombs you have just seen.

Enjoy time to admire the monumental setting and take photographs, while your guide explains the stories and symbolism behind the temple's architecture.

Stop at the Colossi of Memnon

Before leaving the West Bank, pause beside the Colossi of Memnon. These enormous seated statues once stood at the entrance to the mortuary temple of Amenhotep III.

Their scale offers another perspective on the ambition of Egypt's ancient rulers. Listen to your guide's account of the monument and capture photographs before continuing toward Luxor's East Bank.

This short stop connects the royal tombs and temples into a broader picture of ancient Thebes.

Walk Among the Columns of Karnak Temple

Continue your Private Luxor Day Trip from El Quseir at the extraordinary Karnak Temple Complex. Walk through the Great Hypostyle Hall, where 134 massive columns rise above visitors, and discover courtyards, obelisks, and reliefs created over many centuries.

With your Egyptologist, learn why Karnak was central to the worship of Amun and how successive pharaohs expanded the complex. Rather than simply passing through a famous attraction, you can understand the purpose behind its imposing architecture.

A Luxor day tour from El Quseir that combines Karnak with the West Bank provides an unusually rich introduction to the civilization, from royal burials to monumental religious buildings.

Take a break for the oriental buffet lunch included in your package. Water and soft drinks are also included in the advertised arrangements, helping you recharge before the final part of your visit.

Your itinerary includes time to browse Luxor's local market, where you can look for spices, alabaster souvenirs, crafts, and gifts. Shopping is optional, and personal purchases are not part of the tour price.

tours.rawDescription:
Turn your Port Ghalib holiday into a journey through 4,500 years of history. This private Cairo Day Trip from Port Ghalib takes you from the Red Sea marina to Egypt’s capital to explore the Giza Pyramids, the Great Sphinx, the Grand Egyptian Museum and historic Old Cairo, all in one well-organized day with your own small group and Egyptologist guide.

A Private Cairo Tour from Port Ghalib, Without the Big Bus

Your group of up to 8 travels in its own air-conditioned vehicle: a sedan for 1–3 people, a minivan for 4–5, or a Toyota HiAce for larger groups. With no crowds and no waiting for other passengers, you can rest on the drive and enjoy a guide who focuses on your group alone.

The Pyramids of Giza & the Great Sphinx

Arrive at the Giza Plateau in the morning and stand at the base of the Great Pyramid of Khufu, the last surviving Wonder of the Ancient World. Take in the pyramids of Khafre and Menkaure, then continue to the Great Sphinx, carved from a single ridge of limestone more than 4,500 years ago.

Your Egyptologist guide explains how the pyramids were built, who they were built for, and where to capture the best photos.

Tutankhamun’s Treasures at the Grand Egyptian Museum

Next, visit the Grand Egyptian Museum, the world’s largest archaeological museum devoted to one civilization, just minutes from the pyramids.

Walk up the Grand Staircase among statues of kings and gods, meet the colossal statue of Ramses II, and explore the complete Tutankhamun collection, displayed together in one place for the first time.

Lunch, Old Cairo & Souvenir Shopping

Refuel with an oriental buffet lunch before heading to Old Cairo, a district where Coptic and Islamic history sit side by side in narrow streets and historic landmarks. Before the drive back, enjoy time to shop for papyrus, perfume oils and handmade Egyptian souvenirs.

Before You Book

The road from Port Ghalib to Cairo takes around 7 to 8 hours, so the tour starts with a pickup around midnight and you reach Giza in the morning. Your exact pickup time depends on your hotel and is confirmed after booking.

Want to break up the journey?Choose our 2-Day Cairo Overnight Tour from Port Ghalib and spend a night in Cairo.

Stand on the Giza Plateau before the extraordinary Great Pyramid of Khufu, the only surviving Wonder of the Ancient World. See the neighboring pyramids of Khafre and Menkaure and appreciate the scale of monuments built thousands of years ago.

Your guide brings the setting to life with accessible explanations of ancient Egyptian rulers, pyramid construction, and the purpose of these royal monuments. Take photographs from memorable viewpoints while learning the stories behind the landscape.

Meet the Great Sphinx of Giza

Continue to the Great Sphinx, one of Egypt's most recognizable ancient monuments. With a human head and lion's body, this monumental sculpture has watched over the Giza landscape for millennia.

A major highlight is the museum's Tutankhamun Galleries, home to the treasures associated with the young pharaoh's tomb. Admire goldwork, funerary objects, and craftsmanship while your guide helps you understand their significance.

The museum contains far more than anyone can appreciate in a brief stop, so this visit concentrates on highlights within the time available. Entry is arranged according to museum availability and timed-ticket rules, and the published entrance fee is charged separately from the base tour price.

Visit the Magnificent Philae Temple

One of the highlights of your Aswan day tour is the beautiful Philae Temple, dedicated primarily to Isis, one of ancient Egypt's most important goddesses.

Enjoy a boat crossing to Agilkia Island, where the temple complex stands in a spectacular setting surrounded by water.

Discover impressive stone gateways, elegant columns, and intricate reliefs as your guide explains the history and religious significance of this remarkable archaeological site.

Learn how the temple was relocated to Agilkia Island as part of an international effort to protect important Nubian monuments from rising waters.

Philae offers an unforgettable combination of ancient Egyptian architecture, captivating history, and beautiful waterfront scenery.

Explore the Aswan High Dam

Continue your sightseeing experience with a visit to the impressive Aswan High Dam, one of Egypt's most significant modern engineering achievements.

Learn how the dam transformed the management of the Nile's waters, supported hydroelectric power generation, and played an important role in the country's modern development.

Admire views of the surrounding landscape and discover the story of the enormous engineering project that led to the creation of Lake Nasser.

Your guide will explain the dam's historical importance and its lasting impact on Egypt.

Discover the Ancient Unfinished Obelisk

Step back into ancient Egypt at the fascinating Unfinished Obelisk, located in Aswan's historic granite quarries.

This enormous monument provides an exceptional opportunity to understand how ancient Egyptian craftsmen worked with massive blocks of stone.

See the unfinished structure still connected to its original bedrock and learn about the techniques used to shape obelisks for temples and ceremonial spaces.

Your Egyptologist guide will explain why the obelisk was abandoned and what it reveals about ancient Egyptian engineering and craftsmanship.

The quarry is one of the most interesting archaeological sites in Aswan for travelers who want to look beyond the famous temples.

Enjoy a Traditional Nile Felucca Experience

Aswan is famous for its beautiful Nile scenery, peaceful islands, and traditional sailing boats.

As part of the advertised sightseeing program, enjoy the opportunity to experience a traditional felucca ride on the Nile, taking in views of the surrounding landscape and the distinctive atmosphere of southern Egypt.

Relax as you admire the river, islands, and desert scenery that make Aswan one of Egypt's most picturesque destinations.

The exact sailing arrangements and availability depend on the confirmed itinerary, local conditions, and the operator's schedule.

Take a break from exploring Aswan's monuments with an included oriental buffet lunch.

Depending on the available time, you may also have an opportunity to visit Aswan's local market, known for its colorful spices, traditional handicrafts, souvenirs, and Nubian-inspired products.

Browse the market's stalls, discover local gifts, or simply enjoy the atmosphere of this historic Nile Valley city.

A central highlight of your El Quseir Historical City Tour is the Ottoman Castle, also known as El Quseir Fort. Built to protect the port, residents, and important travel routes, this historic stronghold tells the story of the town's former strategic role on the Red Sea coast.

El Quseir's history did not end with the Ottoman period. In the twentieth century, the Italian-run phosphate industry brought new buildings and workers to the town, leaving a distinctive architectural legacy.

The itinerary includes the former Italian Phosphate Factory area, where you can learn about this industrial chapter and see surviving heritage structures where access permits. The factory complex is a historic site, not an operating attraction designed for unrestricted exploration.

The tour also includes the Church of Mary and the town's religious heritage. Its history is linked to the Italian community and the former St. Barbara church, later associated with the local Coptic congregation.

Effective rescue starts long before an emergency. During your PADI Rescue Diver training, you'll learn to identify signs of stress, equipment difficulties, unusual behavior, and situations that could put divers at risk.

The practical course includes ten rescue exercises covering a range of situations at the surface and underwater. You'll learn approaches for assisting tired or panicked divers, locating a missing diver, and responding to a diver showing distress below the surface.

tours.rawDescription:
Discover the underwater beauty of the Red Sea on the Royal Seascope Hurghada Tour, a unique semi-submarine experience that lets you observe colorful coral reefs and tropical fish without needing to scuba dive. Combining panoramic underwater viewing with a snorkeling stop, this Hurghada submarine tour is an excellent choice for families, couples, and travelers who want to explore the marine world in comfort.

Royal Seascope Semi-Submarine Tour in Hurghada

Your Royal Seascope Hurghada trip begins at the marina, where you board the Royal Seascope boat for a short cruise of approximately 15 minutes toward a beautiful coral reef area in the Red Sea.

Once the boat reaches the viewing location, descend to the air-conditioned underwater observation cabin, situated approximately three meters below sea level. Large panoramic windows provide clear views of the underwater environment, allowing you to observe colorful coral formations, tropical fish, and fascinating marine life without entering the water.

Spend approximately 45 minutes enjoying the underwater scenery from the comfortable observation deck. This semi-submarine experience is ideal for non-swimmers, families with children, and anyone who wants to discover the Red Sea's marine life without scuba diving.

Red Sea Coral Reefs and Snorkeling Stop

After the underwater viewing session, the experience continues with a snorkeling stop lasting approximately 30 minutes. If you enjoy swimming, you can enter the water and explore the reef environment more closely, with opportunities to observe tropical fish and coral formations in their natural habitat.

Snorkeling is optional and subject to sea conditions and the crew's safety instructions. If you prefer to remain onboard, you can continue enjoying the views and the surrounding Red Sea scenery.

By combining underwater observation and snorkeling, the Royal Seascope Submarine Hurghada experience offers two different ways to discover the region's marine environment during one trip.

What to Expect from Your Hurghada Semi-Submarine Tour

The Royal Seascope excursion lasts approximately two hours, making it a convenient activity to add to your Hurghada holiday without committing to a full-day boat trip. The program typically includes a short cruise to the reef, approximately 45 minutes of underwater viewing, and a snorkeling stop of around 30 minutes.

The air-conditioned observation cabin provides a comfortable setting for viewing the underwater world, while the snorkeling stop offers an additional opportunity to experience the Red Sea from the water.

Whether you are searching for a Royal Seascope tour, a Hurghada semi-submarine trip, or an underwater sightseeing experience suitable for non-divers, this excursion offers a memorable way to discover the coral reefs and marine life of the Red Sea.

Book your Royal Seascope Hurghada Tour and enjoy panoramic underwater views, colorful coral reefs, and an optional snorkeling experience in one convenient Red Sea excursion.

With a private speedboat, you avoid crowded tours and enjoy a flexible snorkeling experience at one of Hurghada's top marine destinations.

Whether you choose the 4-hour half-day trip or the 8-hour full-day adventure, you'll snorkel vibrant coral reefs, discover tropical fish, rays, moray eels, and enjoy an unforgettable wildlife experience guided by professionals who follow responsible dolphin interaction practices.

Why You'll Love This Trip

Dolphin House Hurghada is one of the Red Sea's most famous snorkeling sites and one of the best places to see wild dolphins in their natural habitat. The calm lagoon at Shaab El Erg Reef makes it ideal for beginners, families, couples, and experienced snorkelers alike.

A private speedboat from Hurghada gives you more flexibility, fewer crowds, and extra time in the water, creating a more personal and relaxing adventure.

Your trip begins with hotel pickup and transfer to the marina, where you'll board your private speedboat to Shaab El Erg Dolphin House. After a safety briefing, enjoy guided snorkeling through coral gardens and the sheltered lagoon while searching for wild dolphins, colorful reef fish, and other fascinating Red Sea marine life before cruising back to Hurghada.

The full-day option offers additional snorkeling stops around Dolphin House Hurghada, giving you more time to explore different coral reefs and increasing your chances of encountering wild dolphins. Fresh fruit, soft drinks, and an optional onboard lunch make this a complete Red Sea adventure.

tours.rawDescription:
Discover the incredible marine life of the Red Sea on a Marsa Mubarak Dugong Snorkeling Trip from Marsa Alam. Located near Port Ghalib, Marsa Mubarak is a renowned snorkeling destination where you can explore clear waters, vibrant coral reefs, seagrass meadows, and the natural habitat of wild dugongs and green sea turtles.

Dugongs & Sea Turtles at Marsa Mubarak

Marsa Mubarak is particularly famous for its dugong encounters and green sea turtles. The bay's seagrass areas provide an important feeding habitat for these marine animals, giving you the opportunity to observe them in the wild during your snorkeling sessions.

A dugong or sea turtle sighting cannot be guaranteed because these are wild animals, but Marsa Mubarak is well known for the possibility of encountering both. Even without a dugong encounter, the bay offers a rewarding underwater experience with coral formations, colorful reef fish, and diverse Red Sea marine life.

Snorkeling in Marsa Mubarak Bay

After hotel pickup from Marsa Alam, you'll travel to Port Ghalib Marina and board the boat for your journey to Marsa Mubarak Bay. Once you arrive, you'll have the opportunity to explore the clear Red Sea waters with guided snorkeling sessions around the reef and seagrass areas.

The combination of relatively calm waters, coral reefs, and rich marine biodiversity makes Marsa Mubarak snorkeling suitable for both first-time snorkelers and more experienced swimmers, subject to sea and weather conditions.

What to Expect on the Trip

Your Marsa Alam dugong snorkeling experience combines marine wildlife, reef exploration, and a relaxing boat trip on the Red Sea. During the first snorkeling stop, keep an eye out for dugongs, green sea turtles, colorful tropical fish, and other marine life that inhabit the bay.

After snorkeling, relax onboard and enjoy a freshly prepared buffet lunch while taking in the surrounding Red Sea scenery. The trip then continues with another snorkeling stop, giving you more time to explore the underwater environment and look for marine wildlife before returning to Port Ghalib Marina and your hotel in Marsa Alam.

If you're looking for a Marsa Mubarak snorkeling trip from Marsa Alam, this experience offers the chance to discover one of the Red Sea's most remarkable marine wildlife destinations while enjoying guided snorkeling, a boat trip, lunch, snorkeling equipment, and hotel transfers.

Discover the ancient treasures of Luxor on a private day trip from Marsa Alam, traveling from the Red Sea coast to the heart of ancient Egypt in one carefully planned day. With a private air-conditioned vehicle and a professional Egyptologist guide, you'll explore the Valley of the Kings, Temple of Hatshepsut, Colossi of Memnon, and Karnak Temple Complex while enjoying the flexibility of a private tour.

Explore the West Bank of Luxor

Your journey begins with an early morning pickup from your hotel in Marsa Alam and a comfortable drive through the desert and Nile Valley toward Luxor. On the West Bank, visit the Valley of the Kings, where ancient pharaohs were buried in elaborately decorated tombs carved into the mountains.

Continue to the Temple of Hatshepsut, one of Luxor's most distinctive ancient monuments, before stopping at the Colossi of Memnon, the enormous statues that have stood at the entrance to Amenhotep III's mortuary temple for thousands of years. Your Egyptologist guide will explain the history and significance of each site throughout the visit.

Karnak Temple & Optional Nile Experience

After exploring the West Bank, cross to Luxor's East Bank for a visit to the Karnak Temple Complex, one of ancient Egypt's largest and most impressive religious sites. Walk among monumental columns, obelisks, statues, and temple remains while learning about the rulers and religious traditions that shaped the complex over centuries.

You'll also enjoy lunch at a local restaurant before continuing the day. If you want to add more to your Luxor experience, an optional Banana Island Nile cruise is available at an additional cost, offering a relaxing change of pace and views of the Nile Valley.

What to Expect on Your Private Luxor Day Trip

This Marsa Alam to Luxor day trip is designed for travelers who want to explore Luxor without spending the night away from the Red Sea coast. This 2-Day Cairo Tour from Marsa Alam gives you time to enjoy Egypt’s capital properly. Instead of squeezing everything into one long day, you’ll explore the Giza Pyramids, the Great Sphinx and the Grand Egyptian Museum on day one, rest overnight in a 4-star Cairo hotel, then discover Saladin Citadel and the Khan El Khalili bazaar on day two.

Why Choose a Cairo Overnight Tour from Marsa Alam?

The road from Marsa Alam to Cairo is long, and a night in the city makes the whole trip far more comfortable. You get more time at each site, a proper night’s sleep, and a slower pace that suits couples and families traveling with children.

Day 1: The Pyramids, the Sphinx and the Grand Egyptian Museum

After a midnight pickup from your hotel, travel to Cairo and meet your Egyptologist guide on the Giza Plateau. Stand at the foot of the Great Pyramid of Khufu, see the pyramids of Khafre and Menkaure, and get close to the Great Sphinx.

Continue to the Grand Egyptian Museum, where you’ll climb the Grand Staircase, see the colossal statue of Ramses II and explore the complete Tutankhamun collection. After lunch, check in to your hotel to rest, then enjoy dinner and an overnight stay.

Day 2: Saladin Citadel and Khan El Khalili

After breakfast at the hotel, visit Saladin Citadel and the Mosque of Muhammad Ali, with sweeping views over the domes and minarets of historic Cairo. Then wander through Khan El Khalili, the city’s famous centuries-old bazaar, to shop for spices, lanterns, perfume oils and handmade souvenirs. After lunch, begin your journey back to Marsa Alam.

Good to Know

Cairo is around 8 hours by road from Marsa Alam, so the tour starts with a pickup around midnight. Your exact pickup time is confirmed after booking based on your hotel’s location.

 

Short on time? Choose our Cairo Day Trip from Marsa Alam and see the Pyramids and the Grand Egyptian Museum in a single day.
