tours.rawDescription:
Discover Egypt's most famous ancient treasures and historic landmarks on a 2-Day Cairo Tour from Port Ghalib. This private overnight journey takes you from your Red Sea resort to the Great Pyramids of Giza, the Sphinx, the spectacular Grand Egyptian Museum, and the historic heart of Cairo, with one night of hotel accommodation included.

Travel in a private air-conditioned vehicle, explore with a professional Egyptologist guide, and enjoy a well-organized itinerary that combines ancient history, Islamic architecture, and local Egyptian culture. With hotel pickup and return transfers from Port Ghalib, a Cairo hotel stay, dinner, and two lunches included, this experience is ideal for travelers who want to discover more of Egypt beyond the Red Sea.

Start Your 2-Day Cairo Tour from Port Ghalib

Your Cairo adventure begins with pickup from your hotel in Port Ghalib and a private transfer toward Egypt's capital.

The scheduled departure is around midnight, subject to your hotel location and confirmed pickup arrangements. Travel through the Eastern Desert in an air-conditioned vehicle before arriving in the Cairo and Giza area to begin your sightseeing program.

With dedicated private transportation and a professional guide, you'll explore some of Egypt's most important attractions over two days instead of trying to fit everything into a single-day excursion.

The tour combines the ancient wonders of Giza with Cairo's impressive museums, historic mosques, and traditional markets.

Day 1 — Discover the Great Pyramids of Giza and the Sphinx

Begin your first sightseeing day with a visit to the legendary Giza Pyramids, home to the Great Pyramid of Khufu, the Pyramid of Khafre, and the Pyramid of Menkaure.

Stand before the Great Pyramid, the last surviving Wonder of the Ancient World, and learn about the remarkable engineering, royal history, and beliefs behind these monumental structures.

Continue to the iconic Great Sphinx of Giza, the enormous limestone statue with the body of a lion and the head of a human.

Your Egyptologist guide will share fascinating stories about the pharaohs, the construction of the pyramid complex, and the role these monuments played in ancient Egyptian civilization.

The Giza Plateau offers unforgettable views and photography opportunities, making it one of the highlights of your Cairo overnight trip.

Explore the Grand Egyptian Museum

Continue your first day with a visit to the magnificent Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM), located near the Giza Pyramids.

Discover an extraordinary collection of ancient Egyptian artifacts, monumental statues, and remarkable treasures that tell the story of one of the world's most influential civilizations.

Explore the museum's impressive exhibition galleries and discover the legacy of Tutankhamun, including artifacts from his famous royal tomb.

The museum provides a fascinating opportunity to understand the art, culture, religion, and achievements of ancient Egypt through carefully presented collections.

Your guide will help you appreciate the significance of the exhibits and their connections to the monuments and historical figures you've encountered during your tour.

Museum admission is subject to the applicable entrance ticket and available visiting arrangements.

Enjoy Your Overnight Hotel Stay in Cairo

After exploring the pyramids and museum, enjoy lunch before transferring to your Cairo hotel.

Check in, relax, and enjoy some time away from the busy sightseeing schedule.

Dinner is included at your hotel on the first evening, giving you an opportunity to unwind before continuing your cultural adventure the following day.

The overnight stay is one of the main advantages of this two-day Cairo excursion from Port Ghalib. It allows you to divide the sightseeing program across two days, rather than completing all visits before an immediate return journey.

Day 2 — Visit Saladin Citadel and Mohamed Ali Mosque

Your second day focuses on the architectural and cultural heritage of historic Cairo.

Visit the impressive Saladin Citadel, a historic fortress overlooking the city, and discover its role in Egypt's medieval history.

Inside the Citadel complex, explore the magnificent Mosque of Mohamed Ali, also known as the Alabaster Mosque.

Admire its grand domes, elegant minarets, and beautiful Ottoman-inspired architecture while learning about the history of Mohamed Ali Pasha and modern Egypt.

The Citadel also offers memorable views across Cairo, providing a different perspective on the country's vibrant capital.

Explore Khan El Khalili Bazaar

Continue your sightseeing adventure with a visit to Khan El Khalili Bazaar, one of Cairo's most famous historic markets.

Walk through lively streets filled with traditional shops selling lanterns, handmade souvenirs, jewelry, spices, and Egyptian handicrafts.

Experience the atmosphere of historic Cairo, browse for gifts, and discover the everyday cultural traditions that make this part of the city so distinctive.

Your guide will help you navigate the market and explain the historical importance of the surrounding area.

After the scheduled sightseeing and your second included lunch, begin the return journey to Port Ghalib in your private air-conditioned vehicle.

Why Choose a Cairo Overnight Tour from Port Ghalib?

This private two-day Cairo experience offers an opportunity to discover Egypt's capital while enjoying the convenience of an organized excursion from your Red Sea accommodation.

Private transportation: Travel with your booking party in a dedicated air-conditioned vehicle, with pickup and return transfers from your Port Ghalib hotel.

Professional guided sightseeing: Discover the history of the pyramids, Egyptian artifacts, and Cairo's architectural heritage with an expert guide.

One-night hotel accommodation: Stay overnight in Cairo and enjoy an itinerary spread across two sightseeing days.

Famous historical attractions: Combine the Pyramids of Giza, the Sphinx, Grand Egyptian Museum, Saladin Citadel, Mohamed Ali Mosque, and Khan El Khalili Bazaar.

Meals included: Enjoy dinner on your first evening and lunch on both sightseeing days.

The tour is suitable for couples, families, small groups, and history enthusiasts who want to experience Cairo and Giza while staying in Port Ghalib.

What's Included in Your 2-Day Cairo Tour?

Your advertised tour package includes:

  • Round-trip hotel pickup and drop-off in Port Ghalib.

  • Private air-conditioned transportation throughout the journey.

  • A professional licensed guide in the agreed language.

  • One night of hotel accommodation in Cairo.

  • Dinner at the hotel on Day 1.

  • Lunch on Day 1 and Day 2.

  • Transportation between scheduled sightseeing attractions.

Important booking information: Entrance fees for the sightseeing attractions are not included in the advertised base price. Entrance fees of $70 per person are mandatory.

Gratuities, personal expenses, additional drinks and snacks, and optional activities are also excluded.

Please review the final package price, entrance ticket arrangements, hotel details, and confirmed pickup schedule before booking.

Book Your 2-Day Cairo Tour from Port Ghalib

Turn your Red Sea holiday into an unforgettable journey through ancient Egyptian history and the cultural treasures of Cairo.

Explore the Pyramids of Giza, discover the collections of the Grand Egyptian Museum, visit the historic Cairo Citadel, and experience the atmosphere of Khan El Khalili — all with private transportation, an expert guide, and overnight accommodation arranged for you.

Starting from just $12 per person, this shared sightseeing experience is an excellent way to discover authentic Egyptian culture beyond the beaches and resorts. Enjoy convenient hotel pickup, guided visits to El Quseir's most interesting landmarks, time for souvenir shopping, and a relaxing seaside café stop before returning to Port Ghalib.

Start Your El Quseir Group Tour from Port Ghalib

Your cultural adventure begins with hotel pickup in Port Ghalib and a comfortable shared transfer along the beautiful Red Sea coast.

Leave the modern marina behind and head to the historic town of El Quseir, where traditional architecture, old streets, and fascinating landmarks offer a completely different holiday experience.

Enjoy the company of fellow travelers as your guide introduces the town's highlights and leads you through an engaging sightseeing program.

This shared El Quseir excursion combines convenient transportation, local discovery, and excellent value, making it a great choice for travelers who want to explore more of Egypt without booking a private tour.

Explore El Quseir Ottoman Castle

Discover one of the town's most famous attractions, the historic El Quseir Castle, also known as the Ottoman Fort.

Step inside this impressive coastal fortress and explore its old stone walls, historic courtyards, and fascinating architectural features.

Admire views of the surrounding town and Red Sea coastline while your guide brings El Quseir's maritime past to life.

Capture memorable photographs and experience one of the highlights of your guided city tour.

The Ottoman Castle entrance ticket costs an additional $5 per person, paid locally.

Discover El Quseir Old Town and Historic Harbour

Continue your sightseeing experience through El Quseir Old Town, where narrow streets, traditional buildings, and historic landmarks reveal the town's distinctive character.

Explore the old harbour area and admire the architectural details that make El Quseir different from the modern Red Sea resorts.

Your group tour also includes the historic Italian Phosphate Factory and Church of Mary, two landmarks that showcase important chapters of the town's industrial and cultural heritage.

Enjoy discovering these memorable places with your guide while taking photographs of the colorful buildings, coastal scenery, and traditional surroundings.

Explore Traditional Markets and Local Bazaars

Experience the lively atmosphere of El Quseir's traditional shopping streets and local markets.

Walk through charming old neighborhoods, admire historic mosques, and browse shops selling Egyptian souvenirs, spices, handicrafts, and locally inspired gifts.

Enjoy the chance to discover the everyday character of an authentic Egyptian coastal town while exploring its markets with your group.

Whether you're shopping for holiday keepsakes or simply enjoying the colorful streets, this stop adds a vibrant local experience to your El Quseir sightseeing tour.

Relax at a Seaside Café on the Red Sea

After exploring the historic landmarks and local markets, take a relaxing break at a seaside café.

Enjoy a refreshing included drink while admiring the beautiful coastal atmosphere and taking in the peaceful Red Sea views.

It's a pleasant way to complete your sightseeing experience before your shared return transfer to your hotel in Port Ghalib.

Why Book This Shared El Quseir Tour With Marsa Waves?

Enjoy an affordable cultural excursion that brings together some of El Quseir's most interesting sights in one organized experience.

Your tour offers:

  • Affordable Group Experience: Discover El Quseir with fellow travelers from just $12 per person.

  • Local Markets: Browse Egyptian souvenirs, handicrafts, and colorful bazaars.

  • Guided Sightseeing: Explore the town's highlights with knowledgeable assistance.

  • Seaside Café Stop: Relax with a refreshing drink overlooking the Red Sea.

This shared city tour is an excellent choice for couples, families, solo travelers, and holidaymakers looking for an affordable cultural experience away from the resort.
